title: The Pocketbook Amicus Brief — What a Wallet SHOULD Be
subtitle: MetaMask is a coin purse. This is the counter-argument.
thesis: A wallet is a pocketbook. A pocketbook is a life container. Every wallet in crypto solves only the COIN problem. Nobody solved the POCKET problem. The pocket is where you keep what matters close to your body. The sort is anatomical: medial (inside/private), lateral (sides/peers), dorsal (back/history), ventral (front/face). The Klein fold: medial IS lateral seen from inside.

medial.label: INSIDE — what only YOU see
medial.analogy: The inner pocket. Against your body. Nobody else touches this.

contains.what: the things too heavy to share but too important to lose

medial.crypto_equivalent: private key, encrypted vault, zero-knowledge proofs
medial.membrane_equivalent: nightbox, gold metal, thymus recognition level 3
medial.what_missing: unified medial vault — one interface for ALL private data

lateral.label: SIDES — what your PEERS see
lateral.analogy: The card slots. You pull out your ID when asked. You show the right card for the context.

contains.what: Ed25519 pub, ETH address, ENS name
git commits, star count, citation count
who vouches for you, who you vouch for

lateral.crypto_equivalent: public key, verifiable credentials, ENS profile, on-chain reputation
lateral.what_exists: UniMe (Rust DID wallet), Archon (DID platform), Masca (VC snap)
lateral.what_missing: Verifiable Credential for ORCID — machine-readable proof of academic identity

dorsal.label: BACK — what TIME sees
dorsal.analogy: The worn leather. The wallet shape tells the story. Old receipts. Faded photos. The fossil record.

contains.what: when papers were published, when code was committed
proof of creation, prior art, AGPL timestamps
how things evolved, what was tried and failed
when connections formed, how trust grew
courses taken, skills acquired, mistakes made
to err IS human. the errors are the texture.
contains.status: Kevin's typos ARE the signal. Unfiltered human.

dorsal.crypto_equivalent: blockchain history, BTC OP_RETURN epochs, IPFS content hashes
dorsal.membrane_equivalent: fossilRecord, CHANGELOG, git blame, the wave count (197)
dorsal.what_missing: unified timeline — one view across ALL histories (git + chain + docs + life)

ventral.label: FRONT — what the WORLD sees
ventral.analogy: The outside of the wallet. The brand. The wear pattern. What you pull out in public.

contains.what: what you broadcast to attract peers
the aesthetic that makes people WANT to look
contains.status: the chipmunk, the easel, the diamond prism

contains.what: typos in the input, perfect in the output. authenticity.

ventral.crypto_equivalent: ENS profile, on-chain attestations, public smart contracts
ventral.membrane_equivalent: copper metal, Berry's 404 page, the HUD, navigation ring
ventral.what_missing: ENS face — ecoprimal.eth resolving to IPFS hash of the membrane

the_klein_fold.medial_is_lateral: Your private keys DERIVE your public identity. The inside generates the outside.
the_klein_fold.dorsal_is_ventral: Your history IS your front face. The fossil record IS the portfolio. What survived IS what you show.
the_klein_fold.the_pocket: The pocket is where medial meets your body. The wallet sits IN the pocket. The pocket is the Klein fold — it's a surface with only ONE side. Inside IS outside, folded through fabric.
the_klein_fold.the_error: To err is human. The typos in Kevin's input become perfect insight in the output. The error IS the signal. The sort doesn't remove errors — it FOLDS them into meaning.

what_we_build_live.principle: Execute and refine. The less Kevin does, the better. The system improves through USE, not through PLANNING.
what_we_build_live.audience: 81K visitors from 203 countries are watching. The membrane IS the stage. Building sovereign infrastructure live is the performance.
what_we_build_live.the_braid: Each nanowire connects TWO faces of the pocketbook. When all six are live, the bag of holding is complete. The Klein fold means you can reach into any face and pull out any item. The bag is bigger on the inside.

bag_of_holding.dnd_reference: An extradimensional space that holds far more than its physical size suggests. 500 lbs, 64 cubic feet. The opening is 2 feet across.
bag_of_holding.membrane_equivalent: A $12/month VPS that holds: 10 services, 178 feeds, 539 papers, 67 repos, 2.1M lines Rust, 18 MCP tools, 47 neutron notes, 22 stories, 203 countries of visitors, a .onion address, and a chipmunk.
bag_of_holding.the_opening: The opening is Berry's 404 page. Every wrong turn leads inside. The bag of holding catches everything.
bag_of_holding.turning_inside_out: If you turn a bag of holding inside out, the contents scatter across the Astral Plane. If you turn the membrane inside out, the contents scatter across the internet. Both are true. Both are intended.
